records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales increased $33.1, or 1.8%, in the second quarter of 2024 when compared to the second quarter of 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We experienced higher unit sales in the second quarter of 2024 primarily due to growth with larger customers and Onsite locations opened in the last two years.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The table below summarizes our absolute and full time equivalent (FTE; based on 40 hours per week) employee headcount, our investments related to in-market locations (defined as the sum of the total number of branch locations and the total number of active Onsite locations), and weighted Fastenal Managed Inventory (FMI) devices at the end of the periods presented and the percentage change compared to the end of the prior periods.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The impact of product pricing on net sales in the second quarter of 2024 was a decline of 30 to 60 basis points, in contrast to the second quarter of 2023, which experienced an increase of 190 to 220 basis points.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash provided by operating activities decreased $44.1 in the second quarter of 2024 when compared to the second quarter of 2023.
